title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements: Hold Extension Terms
content:
**Vehicle Purchase Agreements — terms for extending a vehicle hold.**

**1. Status.** A hold extension is granted only on a deal in reserved status, as shown by the deal's record.

**2. Number of extensions.** A deal may receive no more than the deal type's figure for the most hold extensions in total. A request beyond the extension limit is declined, and the hold runs out on its current expiry date.

**3. Extension length (no longer in force).** The sentence "Each extension moves the hold expiry date forward by the deal type's hold extension days, counted from the current hold expiry date (never from the request date), and raises the extension count by one" is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for how far a hold extension moves the hold.

**4. Fee and deposit (no longer in force).** The sentence "Extensions carry no fee and leave the deposit unchanged" is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for hold extensions and the deposit.

## Clauses 1 and 2 at a glance

| Extensions already granted | Deal type's most extensions | Further request |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | may be granted on a reserved deal |
| 1 | 1 | declined; the hold runs out on its current expiry date |
| 1 | 2 | may be granted on a reserved deal |
| 2 | 2 | declined; the hold runs out on its current expiry date |

A deal in contracted, delivered or any other status other than reserved receives no hold extension.

superseded_clauses: Extensions carry no fee and leave the deposit unchanged.
Each extension moves hold_expires_date forward by hold_extension_days calendar days counted from the current hold_expires_date (never from the request date), and raises hold_extension_count by one.
